risk_summary: The company reports a substantial swing from prior-year net income to a $1.6 million net loss, with results materially affected by debt extinguishment gains, warrant valuation, debt discount amortization, and other non-recurring items. It expects approximately $6.5 million of funding over the next twelve months and acknowledges no assurance of successful financing, indicating high liquidity and refinancing risk.
